applicableAreas: Landscape areas along southern property boundary where overhead electric line runs
findings.comment: Landscape plan shows mitigation tree symbols (+M) along southern boundary near overhead electric line, but does not identify species at these locations. Plant schedule lists species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Mexican Redbud, Texas Mountain Laurel) but does not specify which are planted where. Cannot verify whether non-utility-compatible species are placed within 15 lateral feet of overhead electric conductor without species location documentation.

applicableAreas: Landscape areas along southern property boundary within 25 feet of overhead electric distribution facilities
findings.comment: Proposed shade trees (Cedar Elm, Live Oak) with potential mature heights of 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F are shown on plant schedule, but their specific planting locations relative to overhead electric facilities are not identified on the landscape plan. Landscape plan does not differentiate large trees (40+ feet) from smaller trees. Cannot verify whether trees with mature heights ≥40 feet are positioned within 25 lateral feet of distribution facilities.

applicableAreas: Southeast corner of property near southeast utility pole
findings.comment: Mitigation tree (+M) in southeast corner is proposed at measured distance of 10 feet from southeast utility pole. This distance meets the threshold for trees proposed within 10 lateral feet of overhead electric utility pole, violating UCM § 1.10.10.4 clearance requirements (measurement confidence: medium).

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary and throughout landscape plan where trees are proposed near overhead electric infrastructure
findings.comment: Species of trees proposed near electric facilities are not identified on the landscape plan. Tree symbols on Sheet 31 are labeled only by functional category (+M, +SY, +PL) without species designation. Plant schedule on Sheet 35 lists species (Cedar Elm, Live Oak, Texas Mountain Laurel, Mexican Redbud) but does not indicate which species are planted at which locations on the site, making it impossible to verify species compliance and utility compatibility from submitted documentation.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary and throughout landscape plan where large trees may be proposed
findings.comment: Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are not differentiated on the landscape plan. All proposed trees are shown with identical symbols and labeled only by functional category (M, ST, PL) without notation of mature height or tree size. No legend or symbol distinction indicates which proposed species (such as Cedar Elm or Live Oak) have mature heights of 40+ feet, preventing verification of clearances from overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Southern property boundary where overhead electric line and trees are proposed; throughout site for underground electrical infrastructure
findings.comment: Trees and electric facilities shown on separate plan sheets without clear cross-reference or dimensional relationship. Landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows overhead electric line along southern boundary but does not dimensionally relate tree planting locations to this infrastructure. Underground electrical infrastructure (Sheet 21) showing transformers and pull boxes is not referenced on the landscape plan, preventing clear verification of tree clearances from all electric equipment as required.

applicableAreas: Southeast property corner and southern property boundary where trees are proposed near overhead electric facilities
findings.comment: Plans propose trees near overhead electric facilities (southeast tree measured at 10 feet from pole), but no documented written approval from Austin Energy is visible on the plans, in notes, or in supplementary documents. Cannot verify whether any exceptions to tree clearance requirements have been explicitly approved by Austin Energy as required by UCM § 1.10.10.4.
